The Domestic Acquiring Service Fee is paid monthly and is based on the reported Domestic Acquiring Payments Volume (National and On-Us volumes). Domestic Acquiring Payments Volume represents consolidated spending from all card programs and from all Members sponsored by a Principal Member. Volumes reported monthly will be compared to volumes reported quarterly through the Operating Certificate. The total fees paid will be adjusted accordingly. There is a royalty acquirer fee for this market.

The QCSF is charged to Issuing Members and is based on their reported Card Sales Volume (CSV) obtained from the quarterly Operating Certificates. This volume represents consolidated spending from all card programs and from all banks sponsored by a Principal Member. This fee is settled quarterly and calculated based on a step-tiered system using cumulative year-to-date CSV. The fee rate used for the different tiered steps is dependent upon the partnership level that the Member is committed to achieving.
